subject: AWS Marketplace listing: entitlement footnotes, AMI naming & co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@aws-partners.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace Listing: entitlement footnotes & AMI naming — kickoff

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this on — team at AWS partner ops asked us to run a focused review of the Nimbus AWS Marketplace listing before we move it into the seller console. Main asks from their side: clarify entitlement/trial footnotes, confirm AMI naming and sellerid metadata, and confirm co-sell readiness (demo slate + one-pager).

I've attached a draft of the listing copy and a starter AMI tagging checklist. Could you and your internal product/ops reviewers:
- Call out any legal/claim phrasing that might block approval
- Confirm whether the trial/Private Offer footnote needs revision for our pricing model
- Confirm whether the AMI naming aligns with Nimbus's multi-region bundle strategy

Proposed timeline: quick pass by Oct 4, final sign-off by Oct 8 so we can schedule the onboarding. Copy is below as well if easier.

Thanks —
Elaine
Partner Programs (AWS Marketplace)

Attachments: nimbus-listing-draft-v2.docx, ami-tagging-checklist.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@aws-partners.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace Listing: entitlement footnotes & AMI naming — kickoff

On Thu, Oct 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@aws-partners.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this on — team at AWS partner ops asked us to run a focused review of the Nimbus AWS Marketplace listing before we move it into the seller console.

Appreciate the clear asks, Elaine. Quick initial notes from our side:

- High level: the draft copy is solid. Two areas to tighten: (1) the trial/Private Offer wording (we need to avoid implying unlimited/auto-renew trials) and (2) the hero claim about "sub-50ms inference for 100k qps" — we should either source a benchmark or soften the phrasing.

- Entitlement footnote: we suggest the following short nugget for the footer: "Trial entitlements subject to resource-based limits; private offers have distinct billing and support terms. See trial configuration in the seller console for region-specific limits."

- AMI naming: the attached CSV shows our recommended pattern: nimbus-prod-{region}-{version}-{sellerid}.ami. That keeps image rotation simple for cross-region replication. Soojin will validate the packaging and any required userdata hooks.

Next steps / asks for you:
1) Can AWS confirm whether the seller console requires a specific string for sellerid beyond the standard GUID?
2) Can AWS ops confirm whether a separate footnote is required for "burst capacity" disclaimers?
3) I'll loop in Kimberly for co-sell messaging and a compact demo slate we can surface to field teams.

I'll attach a short co-sell demo slate and draft one-pager; will follow up with Kimberly.

—Marcus
Director, Marketplace & GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: co-sell-demo-slate.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@aws-partners.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace Listing: entitlement footnotes & AMI naming — copy + co-sell notes

Thanks for the ping. A couple of copy edits from a field-enablement perspective:

- Hero line: change from "sub-50ms inference for 100k qps" to "low-latency inference at scale; see performance profiles for workload examples" — keeps claim defensible but still strong.

- Pricing/footnote: add explicit example lines for Private Offer trial: "Private Offer trials are negotiated with the customer and may differ from standard free-trial entitlements; consult your AWS sales rep for terms." That helps procurement and field avoid confusion.

- Co-sell: recommend including a 3-bullet "What the field needs to succeed" box: 1) one-sentence value prop, 2) 3-minute demo flow, 3) expected cost-per-1k tokens at recommended configs. I'll draft the bullets and put them in the one-pager.

Also tagging @soojin_lee for AMI validation (packaging, userdata, and SSH key handling).

Kimberly
Head of Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@aws-partners.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace Listing: entitlement footnotes & AMI naming — tech validation

Quick validation from the packaging team after running the AMI checklist:

- AMI naming: nimbus-prod-{region}-{semver}-{sellerid} is fine. Two implementation notes: ensure sellerid is the 12-digit marketplace-seller ID (we map it at build time) and include a metadata tag "redwood:imageset=v2" to make lifecycle pruning deterministic.

- Userdata: we need to make a small change to the userdata to default to IPv4 only (customers in govcloud reported IPv6 flakes during bootstrap). I'll attach the snippet.

- Security: one more callout — confirm the private offer trial config does not auto-grant high privileges on first boot (we should require explicit customer acceptance to enable full cluster mode).

I'll put the final validated AMI CSV in the internal build bucket. For the seller console, Marcus, we should include the recommended AMI names in the metadata field when uploading so ops can map images to SKUs automatically.

—Soojin
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: ami-tagging-checklist.csv
From: Elaine Chen <elaine.chen@aws-partners.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace Listing: entitlement footnotes & AMI naming — confirm next steps

Thanks everyone — this is great progress. Quick confirmations: 

- AWS Marketplace ops confirms sellerid should be the 12-digit seller GUID. We'll accept the naming pattern and the metadata tag.
- Ops doesn't require a separate burst-capacity footnote for listing approval; include it in the trial/entitlement section instead.
- We'll move the draft to seller console staging once you upload the final doc and AMI mapping by Oct 8.

Action items (agreed):
- Marcus: upload final listing doc (docx) with Kimberly's adjusted hero line and the trial footnote language (by EOD Oct 6).
- Soojin: push finalized ami-tagging-checklist.csv to the build bucket and share the upload path (by Oct 7).
- Kimberly: finalize the 3-bullet field enablement box and the 3-minute demo script; share as a PDF (by Oct 6).
- Elaine/AWS: once uploaded, we'll schedule an onboarding in the seller console and send the HubSpot co-sell play link.

I'll also start a DocuSign envelope for the Marketplace onboarding agreement and share a sandbox link: https://www.docusign.com/sandbox/ABC-1234

Thanks — looking forward to the staging upload.

Elaine
AWS Partner Programs
